about_the_game:
Who hasn’t played Truco with friends, during school break, or sitting around the table while lunch was getting cold?

Truco is part of our culture — part of our conversations, of those long afternoons where winning didn’t matter as much as laughing, raising your voice, and slamming down a card with total confidence.

Truco Argentino brings that magic to the screen, keeping the spirit of the game intact — the one that has always brought us together.
This isn’t some cold, generic card game: it’s an experience made by and for those who feel that Truco is more than just a game — it’s a way to connect, to challenge each other, and to have fun.

🎮 Main Features:

✌️ Single-player mode against an AI that’s anything but basic — it thinks, adapts, and surprises you with every move.

🧠 Each bot has its own personality: one plays it safe, another takes wild risks, and one somehow always seems to know what you’re holding.

📈 A detailed system that tracks your stats, progress, and best games — so you can see how much you’ve improved (or how much you’re still struggling).

🎨 A modern visual style with nostalgic touches — worn cards, scratched wood, and that cozy, familiar game table feeling.

👫 And coming soon: multiplayer mode, to relive those classic games with friends, even if everyone’s at home.

This isn’t just a card game.

It’s Truco. It’s the essence of something bigger.

It’s daring to say “I’m in” even when your hand’s shaking — and learning that sometimes, it’s better to walk away with your head held high.

And if you’ve never played before, don’t worry — you’ll pick it up in two rounds... or become a master at bluffing.
